best_section.where: the far (north-east) corner of the car park, backed up against the tree line away from the entrance and the shed

drivers.seclusion: Backs onto garden plots, trees and what looks like a sports field, not houses. Nearest house-like building is well south, separated by sheds and vegetation.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed car park with marked bays, single driveway in off a quiet lane, plenty of room to turn; no gate or barrier visible.
drivers.traffic: Dead-end community garden car park off a minor lane with a pedestrian path alongside — nothing passes through overnight.
drivers.convention: Two or three cars already parked there in daytime imagery, so a van wouldn't look out of place.
